summary: Choosing a finish for a layer, from the click to the view drawn with it.

steps.does: The person clicks a finish in Colour & finish, or runs it from the palette or a tour.
Checks its capability (offered, exportable or preview only) and commits the finish key.
Changes when the finish needs new optics (Shimmer, Glitter).
Re-rasters that layer's optics only when its optical key changed.
Names the program or uniform the finish needs; the program was compiled ahead.
Draws the views that show the preset.
Updates the package panel's label (preview only, experimental export).

demand: The views showing the preset, and the package panel if open.

faults.when: A finish's program wasn't compiled ahead and links on first use.

latency: Click to drawn under 100 ms (met today: 13–18 ms for every finish, also while a hairstyle loads).
budget.memory: No new memory unless optics re-raster.

invariants: One commit and one look step per click.
A finish that needs no new optics starts no raster job.
The package panel's label always matches the finish shown.
